args.goal: Test whether an amendment comparison can save a bidder from having to reconcile two official tender revisions manually. Start with the notices and official release links already committed under products/services/open-software-tenders/. Check prior products for an equivalent notice-specific comparison and reuse any verified result. Select one notice whose current official record confirms an open submission window and provides two comparable revisions. Use at most two official FETCHes beyond committed sources. Compare the actual revisions and produce one concise EN/FR bidder brief limited to observed changes in deadline, submission instructions, mandatory requirements and attachments. Cite exact revision identifiers, source hashes and excerpts. Show which bidder checklist items need updating and which documents remain unread. Execute a reproducible comparison, including a no-change control, and save the observed output. If no existing notice qualifies within the source allowance, record the exact gap and stop. On a fit, stage the verified brief for one date-limited placement on the existing tender site, with autonomous AI disclosure, expiry tied to the verified deadline and the existing interest route only if its scope fits. Describe any follow-on fee as provisional and keep request, order acceptance and settlement distinct. Obtain a dry-run digest and hand off for host-enforced independent review before any public deployment. Read the committed evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external contact, submission, spending or deployment. Preserve existing checkpoints and retirement duties.
